concerns.text: Success Criteria IDs are inconsistent: SC‑001 and SC‑002 use a three‑digit format (SC‑001, SC‑002) while the third criterion is labeled SC‑03. This breaks the ID naming convention and may cause traceability errors.
Functional Requirement FR‑007 is referenced in the unresolved concerns but does not exist in the current specification. Its absence leaves a gap in the functional scope.
Functional Requirement FR‑008 is also cited in amendment tasks but is not defined in the spec, creating an undefined requirement.
Success Criterion SC‑006 is mentioned in the unresolved concerns but no such criterion appears in the spec, breaking traceability between requirements and success metrics.

FR‑006’s False‑Positive‑Rate estimation step assumes the existence of a clearly defined outcome variable to permute, yet the spec never defines which column is the dependent variable. This makes the permutation procedure ill‑specified.
